desc: Practice a flat lead wrist with Orlivane golf wrist trainers. Each trainer sits on the back of the hand and extends toward the forearm, with an internal firm support board to help limit excessive wrist bending during backswing and downswing practice. The construction combines soft neoprene lining, a PU outer surface and two adjustable hook-and-loop straps. Place the trainer on the back of your hand, wrap the straps, then swing and practice. One size with adjustable straps. Each trainer is about 10.23 in (26 cm) long and weighs about 50 g. Includes 2 black wrist trainers.
b: FLAT WRIST PRACTICE — Wear the trainer across the back of your hand and forearm to practice a flat lead wrist during backswing and downswing drills.
FIRM BACK SUPPORT — An internal firm support board extends along the back of the hand to help limit excessive wrist bending during swing practice.
ADJUSTABLE STRAPS — Two hook-and-loop straps wrap around the wrist and forearm to secure the trainer. One size with adjustable straps.
MATERIALS AND SIZE — Soft neoprene lining with a PU outer surface. Each black wrist trainer is about 10.23 in (26 cm) long and weighs about 50 g.
TWO TRAINERS INCLUDED — The package includes 2 black golf wrist trainers with firm back support and adjustable hook-and-loop straps for swing practice.
